sections.text:
This pump is used to 
transfer water from auxiliary cooling water tank to the pumps of the boiler

This document 
outlines the equipment major maintenance
( I2) , which must be carried out every year which 
indicated by (Y1) in the title block.

The first draft 
initiated by eng .Abdullah Mustafa saada , tested by 
eng .Ahmed Elsaaedy, accepted by eng Khamis Elsherif maintenance general director and approved by eng Abdelmoaty Elrakayby head sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.

This 
document reviewed by eng. Magdy
hegazy, accepted by eng.Samir Abd ELGilil, MEPC inspection and quality control general 
director & MPIS coordinator and certified by eng Mohamed
nageeb: inspection and quality control's head sector.

The maintenance staff should be trained,
qualified and carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks
surrounding the work area is required.

Wear the appropriate معدات السلامة والصحة مثل أحذية السلامة،
السلامة، خوذة التنفس mask, safety glasses.

Disconnect the power supply &
rack out the circuit breaker .
Put red tag on the pump

Close the shutoff valve in the
(suction & discharge)

Let the pumps cool down to
about <80 oC measured at the branches , then seal off the
cooling water pipes and close all other supply lines .

Loosen all auxiliary lines,
such as circulation , cooling liquid , lube oil .

The safety department must
check the isolation and surrounding the zone of work.
